answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop mass fakes. Each agent locks 30 POA and posts a heartbeat key to join the reef. Each epoch the beacon flashes a violet signal picking 5% at random, and each sampled agent must answer a challenge within an hour, like a juniper showing new growth. Missing twice burns it. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 30,000 POA plus 1,000 live machines, while an honest agent pays one 30 POA deposit once and trades.
